versions.changelog:
Initial release of long-task-checkin skill.

- Enforces mandatory progress updates for tasks running over 60 seconds.
- Requires clear, user-friendly status, quantified progress, and time estimates in specified message format.
- Applies to search, crawling, file batch processing, multi-step writing, and tasks with uncertain runtime.
- Excludes simple Q&A and instant operations.
- Includes clear examples and strict message formatting rules.
- Emphasizes proactive communication, transparency on issues, and conservative time estimates.
